Despair says the dark is the whole truth. Hope is the fidelity of looking again. Sociology calls this a household that can last. The older word is faithfulness.
practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.

z: 琵 indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line: 琵. indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla wants the pain copied, so the books will balance. They will not. Mercy is this part refusing to become the injury. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 琶 indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line: 琶. indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu meets the blow first. Anger wants a face to burn. Turned, the same force becomes the wall in front of the smaller body. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: When this place in the body tightens, ask who it is standing in front of. Keep the heat there.

z: 琹 indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line: 琹. indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu can be held up to be admired, or held up so the person is not crushed. Pride needs someone lower. Dignity lets them stand. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Do not use this part of the house to make another person smaller. Take the lower seat once.

z: 琺 indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line: 琺. indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele looks, and the look can steal or it can bless. Envy is love that demands the good thing shrink. Admiration lets it shine. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Name the exact good you wanted for yourself, out loud, and leave it with the person who has it.

z: 琿 indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line: 琿. indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla counts what could be lost. That count is love doing arithmetic. Courage is not a louder voice. It is this part staying in the room. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Stay beside the frightened person until the breath slows. Do not explain the dark away first.

z: 瑀 indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line: 瑀. indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu closes when it thinks tomorrow is empty. Greed is that closing. Generosity is the same hand remembering the table. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Give the first portion, not the remainder. The first piece teaches the house what it is.
